verdict.rationale: WorkOS's own docs show organizations and memberships as first-class objects: the Auth0 migration imports organizations and memberships, roles can be scoped per organization or tenant, and organizations carry custom metadata. Invitation flows are never documented, and memberships appear only in the migration context. Missing for 10: documented invitation flows, dedicated organization/membership API docs beyond migration and RBAC mentions, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-tenant modeling.

support.subject: As a developer, I can model multi-tenant B2B apps with organizations, memberships, and invitation flows out of the box

citations.quote: This produces a migration package with users, organizations, memberships, roles, SSO handoff files, and warnings.
